# nuthatch nest on mainnet

A self-hosted blockchain index. Query it locally; there is no third-party API.

## Contracts
- `link` = 0x514910771af9ca656af840dff83e8264ecf986ca
- `ens` = 0x57f1887a8bf19b14fc0df6fd9b2acc9af147ea85
- `pausable` = 0xebcb31a8465d6130c744c41060e7dcbfa17d1d8a
- `proxy_a` = 0x9bdabf038eeaea56abc17a3b4b9c39e447cba57f
- `proxy_b` = 0x0ed0c116a099b4e626499dc83a6e6799bdad1000
- `roles` = 0xdd2a05fc735c4bc72f9da845c1a5109147d89136
- `vlsquill` = 0x60e71dd36fa5bf92bcd9320e85cf0040ffe437bc
- `deploy_b` = 0x3d5297b22b54d37df8da84e8951f711512a884fc
- `deploy_c` = 0x8997c2469deedade760f84e9328baa2adede426c
- `proxy_admin` = 0xfe05b05a60f34ae974cf6876809fa18f43dba4d1

## Tables (one per contract event)
- `deploy_b__admin_changed` - AdminChanged(address,address) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, previousAdmin, newAdmin)
- `deploy_b__beacon_upgraded` - BeaconUpgraded(address) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, beacon)
- `deploy_b__initialized` - Initialized(uint64) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, version)

- `deploy_b__role_admin_changed` - RoleAdminChanged(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, role, previousAdminRole, newAdminRole)

## Live HTTP API (run `nuthatch dev`)
- `GET /`                    index status
- `GET /tables`              every table with its columns
- `GET /table/{name}?limit=N` recent rows of one table (hot + sealed)
- `GET /entity/{id}`         one row by id (`{block:012}-{logindex:06}`)
- `GET /sql?q=SELECT...`     read-only SQL; each table is a view named `{alias}__{event}`, and each
                             authored view (`views/*.sql`) answers by its own name
- `GET /balances?limit=N`    top holder balances (when an ERC-20 Transfer table is present)
- `GET /balance/{address}`   one address's derived balance
- `GET /queries`             the mount's SQL mode and the queries its operator declared in
                             `mounts.toml` (none on an open nest); `GET /q/{name}` runs one
- `GET /derived`             the nest's incremental entities (`entities.toml`); `GET /derived/{entity}` reads one

## MCP (for coding agents)
Run `nuthatch mcp` (stdio) to expose tools: status, schema, tables, table, sql, entity,
balance, top_balances. Fully offline against the local instance; nothing phones home.
